Name: Chainsaw The Zombies
Overview:
Society has collapsed. Zombies roam the streets. Survive, save the damsel in distress, and chainsaw the zombies!

Chainsaw The Zombies is an indie video game made in the classic 1980s arcade style. Eat all the donuts to win the level. Use the chainsaws and carve your path through the zombies. Save the damsel in distress for bonus points.
